svg.title: Promotion lifecycle
svg.desc: Starts when the page calls next.exitIntent({ image | template }). The popup waits: on a desktop until the mouse leaves through the top of the window; on a touch screen, with mobileScrollTrigger (or disableOnMobile false), until the shopper scrolls past 30% of a screen and back up more than 100px. It opens (promotion.viewed). A click on its image or a data-exit-intent-action button sends promotion.clicked and closes it; apply-coupon applies its code first (coupon.applied or coupon.denied). Esc or the overlay sends promotion.closed with reason dismissed; the × of showCloseButton sends it with reason closed. It waits again while it has opened fewer than maxTriggers times this tab session (default 1).

g.text: mouse out the top, or scroll back up

text.tspan: Starts when the page calls next.exitIntent({ image | template }) · opens up to maxTriggers times a tab session (1)
apply-coupon waits for its code and the new price: coupon.applied (or coupon.denied) first, then promotion.clicked
reason: dismissed (Esc, overlay) or closed (the × of showCloseButton)
